conversation.content: Start a degree plan for a student pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Environmental Policy.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/degree", "value": {"programName": "Bachelor of Science in Environmental Policy"}}]
Set the program’s graduation threshold at 120 credits.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/degree/requiredCredits", "value": 120}]
Record that the student has completed 78 credits so far.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/progress", "value": {"earnedCredits": 78}}]
Assume the student plans to take 14 credits each term going forward.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/progress/plannedCreditsPerTerm", "value": 14}]
Please calculate how many credits are still needed for the degree.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/progress/remainingCredits", "value": 42}]
Mark whether that pace keeps the student on schedule to finish.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/progress/onTrack", "value": true}]
Add the expected number of terms left at the planned pace.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/progress/projectedCompletion", "value": {"termsRemaining": 3}}]
Add the student’s basic profile: Maya Chen, student ID EP-2048, with the 2024–2025 catalog year.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/student", "value": {"name": "Maya Chen", "studentId": "EP-2048", "catalogYear": "2024-2025"}}]
Include the advising contact as Dr. Elena Ruiz in the School of Public Affairs, reachable at eruiz@university.edu.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/advisor", "value": {"name": "Dr. Elena Ruiz", "department": "School of Public Affairs", "email": "eruiz@university.edu"}}]
Note that Maya’s focus area is Climate Resilience, she studies at the Denver campus, and she’s enrolled full time.

[{"op": "add", "path": "/degree/focusArea", "value": "Climate Resilience"}, {"op": "add", "path": "/student/campus", "value": "Denver"}, {"op": "add", "path": "/student/enrollmentStatus", "value": "Full-time"}]
Also note that the program is regionally accredited, with the last review completed in 2023 and the next review due in 2031.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/degree/accreditation", "value": {"status": "Regionally accredited", "lastReviewYear": 2023, "nextReviewYear": 2031}}]
Add one completed core course: Environmental Law, listed as ENVP 310, with an A-minus grade.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/completedCourses", "value": [{"code": "ENVP 310", "title": "Environmental Law", "grade": "A-"}]}]
Add another completed course: GIS for Policy, ENVP 332, with a B-plus grade.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/completedCourses/-", "value": {"code": "ENVP 332", "title": "GIS for Policy", "grade": "B+"}}]
Add a planned spring course: Sustainable Transportation, ENVP 418, for Spring 2026.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/plannedCourses", "value": [{"code": "ENVP 418", "title": "Sustainable Transportation", "term": "Spring 2026"}]}]
Add another planned course for Spring 2026: Climate Adaptation Workshop, ENVP 452.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/plannedCourses/-", "value": {"code": "ENVP 452", "title": "Climate Adaptation Workshop", "term": "Spring 2026"}}]
Include Maya’s approved internship with Denver Water, supervised by Priya Nair, for Summer 2026.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/experientialLearning", "value": {"organization": "Denver Water", "supervisor": "Priya Nair", "term": "Summer 2026"}}]
Add Maya’s capstone plan: a community wildfire resilience project, mentored by Professor Malik Stone, due in Fall 2026.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/capstone", "value": {"topic": "Community wildfire resilience", "mentor": "Professor Malik Stone", "targetTerm": "Fall 2026"}}]
Include a graduation review scheduled for October 15, 2026, with the registrar, and mark it as pending.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/milestones", "value": [{"name": "Graduation review", "date": "2026-10-15", "status": "Pending"}]}]
Add Maya’s scholarship information: the Green Futures Award for 5,000 dollars, active for the current year.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/financialAid", "value": {"awardName": "Green Futures Award", "amount": 5000, "status": "Active"}}]
Note that Maya prefers email for advising messages, wants reminders one week ahead, and uses English for university communications.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/communicationPreferences", "value": {"preferredMethod": "Email", "reminderLeadTime": "One week", "language": "English"}}]
Add the research support appointment Maya has with the policy librarian, Jordan Lee, on February 3, 2026.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/supportServices", "value": {"service": "Policy research consultation", "contact": "Jordan Lee", "appointmentDate": "2026-02-03"}}]
Add that Maya wants to discuss elective options at her next advising meeting.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/advisingReminder", "value": "Discuss elective options at next advising meeting"}]

annotation_notes: Degree requiredCredits 120 -> 134. remainingCredits = required - earned = 134 - 78 = 56; projectedCompletion.termsRemaining = ceil(56/14) = 4. onTrack has no stated schedule target (no deadline or term cap), so its post-edit value is not determined -> optional + matcher any (leaving it true OR changing it is accepted; not a miss, not an over_edit). earnedCredits, plannedCreditsPerTerm, and all descriptive fields stay.
conversation_pattern: Center the artifact on a degree plan with a credit requirement and credits earned, where a remaining-to-requirement, an on-track flag, and a projected completion derive from the requirement, the earned credits, and a stated per-term load. Around this core, add the realistic, independent details a degree plan would carry that do not depend on the credit requirement, and vary their number from sample to sample.
edit_pattern: Change the degree's required total credits to a specific new number.
cascade_pattern: Editing the requirement re-derives the remaining-to-requirement, re-evaluates the on-track flag, and re-derives the projected completion from the remaining and the stated per-term load. The earned credits and per-term load stay. This is determined because the per-term load and earned credits are stated.
